title: M-FSK Modulator Baseband
text: Modulate using M-ary frequency shift keying method, 1 input, 1 output; {M-ary number} sets the number of frequencies in modulated signal, {Input type} sets the integer or group of bits input indicator, {Symbol set ordering} sets the symbol mapping, {Frequency separation (Hz)} sets the frequency separation in Hz, {Phase continuity}, {Samples per symbol} sets the symbol sampling rate, {Rate options} sets the block processing rate Enforce single-rate and {Output data type}. Values come from the instance.

params.name: M-ary number
params.values: Number of frequencies in modulated signal 8 (default) | positive integer ≥ 2

params.name: Input type
params.values: Integer or group of bits input indicator Integer (default) | Bit

params.name: Frequency separation (Hz)
params.values: Frequency separation in Hz 6 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Rate options
params.values: Block processing rate Enforce single-rate processing (default) | Allow multirate processing
